verdict.rationale: Capsule CRM is a SaaS CRM, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server, though. Its REST API with Bearer tokens and its Zapier integration are developer building blocks or adjacent integrations, not an official MCP server, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
